Cost.definition: Cost of transportation for route from terminal i to destination j

objective.description: "Minimize the total transportation cost of shipping soybeans from terminals to destinations"

constraints.description: For each terminal k, the sum of amounts shipped from terminal k to all destinations must equal its supply: sum_j amount_{k,j} = Supply_k
For each destination l, the sum of amounts shipped to destination l from all terminals must equal its demand: sum_i amount_{i,l} = Demand_l
All shipment amounts must be non-negative: amount_{i,j} >= 0 for all routes (i,j) in A
